notes: Deep ref and converted source read in full; all quotations checked against the source. The distillation is strongest on its core subject (per-event participation, non-interference rule, Sprint Review agenda, end users, confidentiality, trust goal) — those claims are faithful and well quoted. Failures cluster in three places: (1) Scrum Guide 2020 text imported as the Field Guide's — three quotations (PO 'represents the needs of many stakeholders', Sprint Goal 'communicates why the Sprint is valuable', DoD 'cannot be released or even presented'), one explicitly attributed to the Field Guide at line 199; (2) role assignments the source does not make (SM owns the non-interference boundary; PO invites to Backlog Refinement; PO as stakeholder representative); (3) cross-reference errors (Letaw chapters, Jones routing, Business Ethics model name, a non-existent PoM eight-question framework). Two errors are inherited from the deep ref: the 'three tiers per event' summary (deep line 7, contradicted by the deep ref's own event sections) and the 'Daily Scrum, Tips' location for the non-interference rule (deep line 340; it is in Participants). The deep ref should be corrected at lines 7 and 340. Omitted borrowed-through items (Derby & Larsen, Shock Therapy, Patton, Cohn) noted, not graded.
